# Metrics

## Metric

* [Gross Margin](gross-margin.md) - Gross margin for a period, per Acme's FY2026 Cost Allocation Standard (product cost + inbound fulfillment + outbound shipping + payment fees). _(verified)_
* [Gross Margin (legacy, pre-FY2026)](gross-margin-legacy.md) - Retired gross-margin definition that included only product cost. Preserved for historical query reproducibility. Do not use for new analyses. _(deprecated, verified)_
* [Revenue](revenue.md) - Recognized revenue for a period, per Acme's FY2026 revenue-recognition policy. Backed by an Attested Computation. _(verified)_
